edges: Louis Lambert falls passionately in love with Pauline de Villenoix.
Louis Lambert experiences a moment of clarity before his wedding to Pauline.
Louis Lambert is taken to Pauline's family's château for solitude and rest.
Louis Lambert dies at the Villenoix château.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Louis Lambert and Balzac become friends at the Collège de Vendôme.
Madame de Staël pays for Louis Lambert to enroll in the Collège de Vendôme.
